subject.title: feat(gateway): system change history RPC and Ask OpenClaw recent-changes panel

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the system/config audit journals through the new `operator.admin` `openclaw.changes.list` protocol and Custodian history surface?
rationale: This is an additive cross-client gateway API and a new operator-facing history feature; the merged write-side journal establishes a prerequisite, but does not by itself decide the permanent reader contract or product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the reader contract after proof
options.body: Confirm the operator-admin API and retention presentation, then require a redacted real end-to-end audit-store-to-Custodian result before landing.

options.title: Keep journaling write-only for now
options.body: Pause this reader surface and retain the merged audit journal until a narrower or differently owned history experience is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the reader contract after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the operator-admin API and retention presentation, then require a redacted real end-to-end audit-store-to-Custodian result before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history shows this person introduced the prerequisite journal and authored the parent phased proposal.
